INSERT INTO etl_audit.pipeline_audit_log (
    datafactory_name,
    pipeline_name,
    run_id,
    source,
    destination,
    trigger_type,
    trigger_id,
    trigger_name,
    trigger_time,
    rows_copied,
    rows_read,
    no_parallel_copies,
    copy_duration_secs,
    effective_integration_runtime,
    source_type,
    sink_type,
    execution_status,
    copyactivity_start_time,
    copyactivity_end_time,
    copyactivity_queuing_duration_secs,
    copyactivity_time_to_first_byte_secs,
    copyactivity_transfer_duration_secs
)
SELECT
    '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text,
    '@{pipeline().Pipeline}'::text,
    '@{pipeline().RunId}'::uuid,
    ''::text,
    ''::text,
    '@{pipeline().TriggerType}'::text,
    '@{pipeline().TriggerId}'::text,
    '@{pipeline().TriggerName}'::text,
    '@{pipeline().TriggerTime}'::timestamp,
    @{activity('EmailProcessor').output.rowsCopied}::bigint,
    @{activity('EmailProcessor').output.rowsRead}::bigint,
    @{activity('EmailProcessor').output.usedParallelCopies}::int,
    @{activity('EmailProcessor').output.copyDuration}::numeric,
    '@{activity('EmailProcessor').output.effectiveIntegrationRuntime}'::text,
    '@{activity('EmailProcessor').output.executionDetails[0].source.type}'::text,
    '@{activity('EmailProcessor').output.executionDetails[0].sink.type}'::text,
    '@{activity('EmailProcessor').output.executionDetails[0].status}'::text,
    '@{activity('EmailProcessor').output.executionDetails[0].start}'::timestamp,
    '@{utcnow()}'::timestamp,
    @{activity('EmailProcessor').output.executionDetails[0].detailedDurations.queuingDuration}::numeric,
    @{activity('EmailProcessor').output.executionDetails[0].detailedDurations.timeToFirstByte}::numeric,
    @{activity('EmailProcessor').output.executionDetails[0].detailedDurations.transferDuration}::numeric
;
